incidents.name: Uniswap V1 imBTC exchange ERC-777 reentrancy
incidents.notes: The Uniswap V1 imBTC exchange updated its reserves after pulling tokens, so imBTC's ERC-777 tokensToSend hook let the attacker re-enter tokenToEthSwapInput() at a stale price and drain the ETH reserve.

sources.ref: onchain review: the imBTC exchange 0xFFcf45b540e6C9F094Ae656D2e34aD11cdfdb187 is a Vyper clone deployed by the Uniswap V1 factory; creation resolved over RPC to 2019-12-06T09:55:01Z, months before the incident and unrelated to the attack sender 0x60f3fdb8...; no EIP-1967 events, age measured from deployment. 1,278 ETH x $173.06 at incidentTimestamp 1587182364 (DefiLlama) = $221,171.

re-check 2026 (deployment-basis rows with a DELEGATECALL in the runtime): CONFIRMED deployment basis. The exchange is a 46-byte Vyper forwarder whose runtime hardcodes the Uniswap V1 exchange template 0x2157a7894439191e520825fe9399ab8655e0f708 as a PUSH20 immediate, so the delegate target cannot be repointed; the template's runtime is byte-identical at 13 sample points across [9059910, 9894154] and callTracer on the exploit tx confirms the forwarder delegatecalls only the template.
